comments.body: A posible drop out of: Normal Treasure Chest and Splendid Treasure Chest

comments.author: benjy20
comments.body:
are there any plates with +15armour or more that could be easy to make?

Thank you ^_ ^

comments.author: Gudebuddha
comments.body:
Basicly 3 Options:

1. If you have Casting then: Maestro's Rolled Iron Plating
2. If you have Casting and do Sea of Wonders Chest runs:
Special Hardened Steel Armouring or Pirate Hyper Hardened Steel Plating or Hyper Hardened Steel Plating
3. You open Normal Treasure Chest and get Specially-processed Hardened Iron Plating with a around 6% drop chance, or out of Splendid Treasure Chest with a slightly higher drop chance.

Which of those are easy enough for you to get depends on what you do.
Everything above 18 is UWC.
